Jambon-beurre baguette bites.d: Crusty French loaf spread thick with cultured butter, layered with shaved leg ham and sliced cornichons, pressed and cut in twelve. Dijon mustard on the side.
Jambon-beurre baguette bites.note: Twelve pieces. Order a day ahead.

Olives and cornichons.d: Mixed olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, thyme and crushed garlic, packed with cornichons and pickled onions.
Olives and cornichons.note: We'll warm it while you wait.

Tony's spaghetti.d: San Marzano tomatoes crushed by hand, garlic cooked gently in olive oil, simmered twenty-five minutes, finished with basil and a knob of butter. Grated parmesan on the side.
Tony's spaghetti.note: Ask for Tony. Private room in the back.

Potted plant dirt cups.d: Dark chocolate mousse layered with crushed chocolate cookie crumbs in a little terracotta tumbler, a sprig of fresh mint planted on top.
Potted plant dirt cups.note: From the bakery case, by the register.

Léon's malted vanilla milkshake.d: Cold whole milk blended with ice cream, malted milk powder and a spoon of honey, poured into a glass frosted in the freezer.
Léon's malted vanilla milkshake.note: Made to order at the lunch counter.
